items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s Week 6 game against the Panthers (hamstring); he missed practice all week. Will Shipley placed on IR.
items.why: Missed all practices; official Friday ruling.
items.implication: Sit everywhere; Eagles backfield thinned further.
items.opportunity: Lead role likely to Dameon Pierce with committee help; reverse any prior Shipley/Barkley handcuff assumptions.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams; will rest for long-term healing.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining ARI backs.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday at Cleveland due to ankle; no practice this week, Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Missed every practice; ankle sprain from prior week.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Huntley streamer/QB2 upside in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass catchers and RBs retain volume under Huntley who has won recent starts.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice and play Week 7. Investigation ongoing but no immediate further impact.
items.why: NFL decision; sources confirm Week 7 eligibility.
items.implication: ROS boost; stash/hold, not available Week 6.
items.opportunity: Returns to lead back role potentially Week 7.

items.text: AJ Brown listed as questionable on Patriots Friday injury report.
items.opportunity: If out, other NE WRs/TE upside.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday at KC; clear to play amid other Chargers outs.
items.implication: Start with confidence; full role expected.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially listed as questionable for Sunday.
items.implication: Monitor; full practice earlier helped but still Q.
items.opportunity: If out, Case Keenum; Bears pass catchers volatility.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (high-ankle sprain) practiced this week and said he feels pretty good; surprised he could practice.
items.why: High-ankle diagnosis but practiced; positive comments.
items.implication: Trending toward availability; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Could reclaim or share carries with Stevenson.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans as his WR4 vs Commanders secondary this week.
items.why: Washington defense buffet for pass catchers; strong matchup.
items.opportunity: High target/volume expected vs soft secondary.
